lines.text: Thanks for joining today, Dan. Let me start by walking you through how Brightpath handles integrations.
We're mainly interested in whether you can connect to our legacy ERP system. That's non-negotiable for us.
Absolutely, we will build a custom ERP connector specifically for Harbor Logistics, that's something we can commit to.
What about single sign-on? Our security team requires SAML.
Yes, we will have SSO live within two weeks of signing. That's a standard part of our onboarding.
We also have about five years of job history we'd need migrated. It's sitting in CSV exports right now.
We'll have the CSV migration done in three weeks from contract signature.
What about the mobile app? Our field techs work offline a lot.
Our app works on iOS and Android and handles standard offline caching today.
We'd need true offline mode, not just caching. Full job management offline.
I understand. The full offline mobile mode will be ready by Q1 of next year, I can commit to that.
That works for our timeline. Kim, do you have questions about the data migration process?
Yes, we'll send the job history export by the 15th of next month so you have time to prepare.
Perfect. We'll need that to kick off the migration work on our side.
One more thing: we really need custom reporting. Can you do that?
We could probably look at custom reports, let me check with the implementation team on what's feasible.
And if you can sign this month, we'll include a ten percent discount on the first year.
That's interesting. We'd also want on-site training for our field supervisors.
We can arrange on-site training for your supervisors, we'll include two days on-site as part of the package.
Good. What about legacy database migration? We have an old Oracle system too.
We will handle the legacy database migration as well, that's something we offer.
How long does a typical implementation take?
Standard implementations run forty-five days from signature to go-live.
We'd need to be live before our Q1 busy season.
Noted. Let's schedule a follow-up to discuss the technical requirements in more detail.
